slug: 2026-06-11 DR Congo to Launch National Digital Identity System RDC-PASS on June 13

facts.fact: The article says RDC-PASS will support biometric authentication of SIM cards and integrate automated e-KYC for financial services providers, under a PPP signed June 2025 giving Trident exclusive e-KYC rights for 20 years, with deployment in stages after the 13 June 2026 launch.

systems.system: automated e-KYC for financial services providers
systems.owner: Trident Digital Tech DRC Africa SAS
